resources.string: The local database can\'t be opened

This device\'s encrypted database can\'t be unlocked. This can happen if the system\'s secure storage (Keystore) got corrupted. You can clear the local data and start fresh; if you had a Google Drive backup, you can restore it from the app afterwards.
Clear local data and start fresh
Couldn\'t clear the local data. Please try again.
The training data saved on this device will be deleted. This can\'t be undone.
